query:
SELECT
    q.name AS quotation_id,
    q.transaction_date,
    q.workflow_state,
    cft.assigned_by,
    cft.assigned_by_name,
    cft.assigned_to,
    cft.assigned_to_name,
    cft.reason,
    cft.time,
    cft.status,
    cft.notes
FROM
    `tabQuotation` q
LEFT JOIN
    `tabFollow Up` cft
    ON q.name = cft.parent
WHERE
    cft.assigned_to IS NOT NULL
    AND cft.assigned_to != ''
    AND (%(start_date)s IS NULL OR q.transaction_date >= %(start_date)s)
    AND (%(end_date)s IS NULL OR q.transaction_date <= %(end_date)s)
ORDER BY
    q.transaction_date DESC, q.name;

name: Sales Order Rohan
query:
SELECT 
    so.transaction_date AS "Posting Date:Date:100",
    so.name AS "Sales Order ID:Link/Sales Order:150",
    so.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    so.customer_name AS "Customer Name:Data:180",
    so.custom_credit_limit_balance AS "Customer Balance:Currency:150",
    so.sales_partner AS "Sales Partner:Link/Sales Partner:150",
    (SELECT st.sales_person FROM `tabSales Team` st WHERE st.parent = so.name LIMIT 1) AS "Sales Person:Data:150",
    so.rounded_total AS "Grand Total:Currency:150",
    (so.rounded_total - COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(per.allocated_amount) 
        FROM `tabPayment Entry Reference` per 
        JOIN `tabPayment Entry` pe ON pe.name = per.parent 
        WHERE per.reference_doctype = 'Sales Order' 
        AND per.reference_name = so.name 
        AND pe.docstatus = 1
    ), 0)) AS "Outstanding Amount:Currency:150",
    so.delivery_date AS "Delivery Date:Date:120",
    -- Check comments for approval
    (SELECT c.owner 
     FROM `tabComment` c 
     WHERE c.reference_doctype = 'Sales Order' 
     AND c.reference_name = so.name 
     AND LOCATE('approved', LOWER(c.content)) > 0
     ORDER BY c.creation DESC 
     LIMIT 1) AS "Approved By:Data:120"
FROM `tabSales Order` so
WHERE so.docstatus < 2
  AND so.workflow_state = 'Approved'
ORDER BY so.transaction_date DESC

        DATE_FORMAT( MIN(`s`.si_date), '%%d-%%m-%%Y') AS "First SI Date:First SI Date:Link/50",
        (CASE WHEN COUNT(`s`.si_date) != 0 THEN 'Sale Invoice'
              WHEN COUNT(`s`.so_date) != 0  THEN 'Sale Order'
              WHEN COUNT(`s`.qt_date) != 0  THEN 'Quotation'
              ELSE 'Opportunity' END) AS "Latest Stage:Latest Stage:Link/50",
        COUNT(`s`.si_date) "Converted:Converted:Int/50"
FROM
    `tabCustomer` AS `cs` JOIN
    (SELECT
     `op`.creation AS `reference_date`,
     `op`.party_name AS `customer`,
     `op`.creation AS `op_date`,
     REGEXP_REPLACE(`op`._assign,'[\\["\\]]','') AS `assign_to`,
     NULL AS `qt_date`,
     NULL AS `so_date`,
     NULL AS `si_date`
     FROM
    `tabOpportunity` AS `op`
    UNION
    SELECT
     `qt`.creation,
     `qt`.party_name,
     REGEXP_REPLACE(`qt`._assign,'[\\["\\]]',''),
     NULL,
     `qt`.creation,
     NULL,
     NULL
     FROM
    `tabQuotation` AS `qt`
     WHERE `qt`.docstatus = 1
    UNION
    SELECT
    `so`.creation,
    `so`.customer,
    REGEXP_REPLACE(`so`._assign,'[\\["\\]]',''),
    NULL,

    `so`.creation,

query:
SELECT
  cs.name AS "Customer:Link/Customer:160",
  cs.customer_name AS "Customer Name:Data:200",

  /* Sales Persons from docs in range */
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT s.sales_person_name ORDER BY s.sales_person_name SEPARATOR ', ')
    AS "Sales Persons (Docs):Data:260",

  /* Sales Persons mapped on Customer master */
  (
    SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT st2.sales_person ORDER BY st2.sales_person SEPARATOR ', ')
    FROM `tabSales Team` st2
    WHERE st2.parenttype = 'Customer' AND st2.parent = cs.name
  ) AS "Sales Persons (Customer):Data:260",

  /* counts by stage (submitted where applicable) */
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity'   THEN s.docname END) AS "Opportunities:Int:100",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation'     THEN s.docname END) AS "Quotations:Int:100",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order'   THEN s.docname END) AS "Sales Orders:Int:110",
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.docname END) AS "Sales Invoices:Int:120",

  /* first dates in range */
  MIN(CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity'   THEN s.reference_date END) AS "First Opportunity Date:Date:150",
  MIN(CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation'     THEN s.reference_date END) AS "First Quotation Date:Date:150",
  MIN(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order'   THEN s.reference_date END) AS "First SO Date:Date:130",
  MIN(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.reference_date END) AS "First SI Date:Date:130",

  /* last dates in range */
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity'   THEN s.reference_date END) AS "Last Opportunity Date:Date:150",
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation'     THEN s.reference_date END) AS "Last Quotation Date:Date:150",
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order'   THEN s.reference_date END) AS "Last SO Date:Date:130",
  MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.reference_date END) AS "Last SI Date:Date:130",

  /* latest stage by most recent doc date (in range) */
  CASE
    WHEN GREATEST(
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation'     THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01'))
    ) = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')) THEN 'Sales Invoice'
    WHEN GREATEST(
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation'     THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01'))
    ) = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')) THEN 'Sales Order'
    WHEN GREATEST(
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation'     THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01'))
    ) = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')) THEN 'Quotation'
    WHEN GREATEST(
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Order'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Quotation'     THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')),
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity'   THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01'))
    ) = COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN s.stage='Opportunity' THEN s.reference_date END), DATE('1000-01-01')) THEN 'Opportunity'
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Latest Stage:Data:130",

  IF(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.stage='Sales Invoice' THEN s.docname END) > 0, 1, 0) AS "Converted:Int:90"

FROM `tabCustomer` cs
LEFT JOIN (
  /* Opportunities (use party_name) */
  SELECT
    op.name AS docname,
    op.party_name AS customer_id,
    op.customer_name,
    COALESCE(op.transaction_date, DATE(op.creation)) AS reference_date,
    'Opportunity' AS stage,
    st.sales_person AS sales_person_name
  FROM `tabOpportunity` op
  LEFT JOIN `tabSales Team` st
    ON st.parenttype = 'Opportunity' AND st.parent = op.name
  WHERE op.party_name IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(op.transaction_date, DATE(op.creation)) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

  UNION ALL

  /* Quotations — submitted; use party_name when quotation_to='Customer' */
  SELECT
    qt.name,
    qt.party_name AS customer_id,
    qt.customer_name,
    COALESCE(qt.transaction_date, DATE(qt.creation)) AS reference_date,
    'Quotation' AS stage,
    st.sales_person AS sales_person_name
  FROM `tabQuotation` qt
  LEFT JOIN `tabSales Team` st
    ON st.parenttype = 'Quotation' AND st.parent = qt.name
  WHERE qt.docstatus = 1
    AND qt.quotation_to = 'Customer'
    AND qt.party_name IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(qt.transaction_date, DATE(qt.creation)) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

  UNION ALL

  /* Sales Orders — submitted */
  SELECT
    so.name,
    so.customer,
    so.customer_name,
    COALESCE(so.transaction_date, DATE(so.creation)) AS reference_date,
    'Sales Order' AS stage,
    st.sales_person AS sales_person_name
  FROM `tabSales Order` so
  LEFT JOIN `tabSales Team` st
    ON st.parenttype = 'Sales Order' AND st.parent = so.name
  WHERE so.docstatus = 1
    AND COALESCE(so.transaction_date, DATE(so.creation)) BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s

  UNION ALL

  /* Sales Invoices — submitted (exclude returns) */
  SELECT
    si.name,
    si.customer,
    si.customer_name,
    si.posting_date AS reference_date,
    'Sales Invoice' AS stage,
    st.sales_person AS sales_person_name
  FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
  LEFT JOIN `tabSales Team` st
    ON st.parenttype = 'Sales Invoice' AND st.parent = si.name
  WHERE si.docstatus = 1
    AND (si.is_return = 0 OR si.is_return IS NULL)
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
) s
  ON cs.name = s.customer_id
GROUP BY cs.name, cs.customer_name
ORDER BY cs.customer_name;

name: item wise sales report
query:
-- MoM Sales for ALL transacted items (Draft + Submitted)
-- qty and value are net of returns; value in company currency (base_net_amount)

SELECT
    DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%Y-%m') AS month,
    sii.item_code                          AS item_code,
    it.item_name                           AS item_name,
    it.custom_brand                        AS custom_brand,
    it.custom_category                     AS custom_category,
    sii.uom                                AS uom,
    SUM(CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -sii.qty              ELSE sii.qty END)             AS qty,
    SUM(CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -sii.base_net_amount ELSE sii.base_net_amount END) AS value
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii ON sii.parent = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` it ON it.name = sii.item_code
WHERE
    si.docstatus IN (0, 1)   -- include Draft (0) + Submitted (1)
    AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
    AND (%(company)s = '' OR si.company = %(company)s)
    AND (%(brand)s   = '' OR it.custom_brand = %(brand)s)
    AND (%(category)s= '' OR it.custom_category = %(category)s)
GROUP BY
    DATE_FORMAT(si.posting_date, '%Y-%m'), sii.item_code, it.item_name, it.custom_brand, it.custom_category, sii.uom
HAVING
    -- only show items that actually transacted (non-zero qty or value) in that month
    (ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -sii.qty              ELSE sii.qty END)) <> 0)
    OR
    (ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN si.is_return = 1 THEN -sii.base_net_amount ELSE sii.base_net_amount END)) <> 0)
ORDER BY
    month ASC, item_code ASC;

query:
SELECT
    si.name AS `Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:200`,
    si.customer AS `Customer`,
    si.territory AS `Territory`,
    sii.warehouse AS `Warehouse`,
    si.posting_date AS `Posting Date`,
    sii.item_code AS `Item Code`,
    (SELECT item_group FROM `tabItem` WHERE name = sii.item_code) AS `Item Group`,
    sii.brand AS `Brand`,

    -- Stock quantity with conversion factor
    (sii.qty * IFNULL(sii.conversion_factor, 1)) AS `SO Total Qty`,

    -- Base net amount
    sii.base_net_amount AS `Amount`,

    -- Tax inclusive amount
    (sii.base_net_amount
        + IFNULL(sii.igst_amount, 0)
        + IFNULL(sii.cgst_amount, 0)
        + IFNULL(sii.sgst_amount, 0)
    ) AS `Tax Inclusive Amount`,

    st.sales_person AS `Sales Person`,
    st.allocated_percentage AS `Contribution Percent`,

    -- Contribution quantity
    ((sii.qty * IFNULL(sii.conversion_factor, 1))
        * st.allocated_percentage / 100) AS `Contribution Qty`,

    -- Contribution amount
    (sii.base_net_amount * st.allocated_percentage / 100) AS `Contribution Amount`,

    -- Contribution tax inclusive amount
    ((sii.base_net_amount
        + IFNULL(sii.igst_amount, 0)
        + IFNULL(sii.cgst_amount, 0)
        + IFNULL(sii.sgst_amount, 0)
    ) * st.allocated_percentage / 100) AS `Contribution Tax Inclusive Amount`,

    si.currency AS `Currency`,
    si.docstatus AS `Docstatus`,
    si.customer_name AS `Customer Name`,
    si.status AS `Status`,
    si.sales_partner AS `Sales Partner`,
    si.is_return AS `Is Return`,
    sii.sales_order AS `Sales Order`,
    sii.custom_room AS `Room`,
    sii.item_name AS `Item Name`,
    sii.uom AS `UOM`,
    sii.price_list_rate AS `Price List Rate`,
    sii.rate AS `Rate`,
    sii.custom_mrp AS `MRP`,
    sii.discount_percentage AS `Disc Percentage`,

    -- Commission fields from Commission Item
    ci.commission_rate AS `Commission Rate`,
    ci.commission_amount AS `Commission Amount`,

    (SELECT MAX(pr.discount_percentage)
        FROM `tabPricing Rule` pr
        WHERE pr.title = sii.brand
          AND pr.selling = 1
          AND pr.docstatus < 2
    ) AS `Max Brand Discount Percent`

FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
INNER JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
    ON sii.parent = si.name
INNER JOIN `tabSales Team` st
    ON st.parent = si.name
   AND st.parenttype = 'Sales Invoice'
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Partner Commission` spc
    ON spc.sales_invoice = si.name
LEFT JOIN `tabCommission Item` ci
    ON ci.parent = spc.name
   AND ci.item_code = sii.item_code

WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.posting_date BETWEEN %(start_date)s AND %(end_date)s
  AND ((sii.qty * IFNULL(sii.conversion_factor, 1)) > 0
       OR si.is_return = 1)

ORDER BY
    st.sales_person,
    si.name DESC;

name: Stock Balance Grouped Warehouse
query:
-- ERPNext Stock Balance Report - Safe SQL Implementation
-- Compatible with most SQL environments, avoids complex window functions

SELECT 
    sle.item_code as "Item:Link/Item:120",
    MAX(item.item_name) as "Item Name:Data:150",
    MAX(item.item_group) as "Item Group:Link/Item Group:120",
    sle.warehouse as "Warehouse:Link/Warehouse:100",
    MAX(item.stock_uom) as "Stock UOM:Link/UOM:90",
    
    -- Balance Quantities (sum of all movements up to to_date)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s 
        THEN sle.actual_qty 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 3) as "Balance Qty:Float:110",
    
    -- Balance Value (sum of all value changes up to to_date)  
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s 
        THEN sle.stock_value_difference 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 2) as "Balance Value:Currency:120",
    
    -- Opening Quantities (before from_date, including opening vouchers)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date < %(from_date)s 
        OR (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND se.is_opening = 'Yes' AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
        OR (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' AND sr.purpose = 'Opening Stock' AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
        THEN sle.actual_qty 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 3) as "Opening Qty:Float:110",
    
    -- Opening Value (before from_date, including opening vouchers)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date < %(from_date)s 
        OR (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND se.is_opening = 'Yes' AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
        OR (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' AND sr.purpose = 'Opening Stock' AND sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s)
        THEN sle.stock_value_difference 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 2) as "Opening Value:Currency:110",
    
    -- In Qty (positive qty in date range, excluding opening vouchers)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s 
        AND sle.actual_qty > 0 
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND se.is_opening = 'Yes')
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' AND sr.purpose = 'Opening Stock')
        THEN sle.actual_qty 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 3) as "In Qty:Float:80",
    
    -- In Value (positive value in date range, excluding opening vouchers)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s 
        AND sle.stock_value_difference > 0 
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND se.is_opening = 'Yes')
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' AND sr.purpose = 'Opening Stock')
        THEN sle.stock_value_difference 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 2) as "In Value:Currency:80",
    
    -- Out Qty (negative qty in date range, shown as positive, excluding opening vouchers)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s 
        AND sle.actual_qty < 0 
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND se.is_opening = 'Yes')
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' AND sr.purpose = 'Opening Stock')
        THEN ABS(sle.actual_qty) 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 3) as "Out Qty:Float:80",
    
    -- Out Value (negative value in date range, shown as positive, excluding opening vouchers)
    ROUND(SUM(CASE 
        WHEN sle.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s 
        AND sle.stock_value_difference < 0 
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' AND se.is_opening = 'Yes')
        AND NOT (sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' AND sr.purpose = 'Opening Stock')
        THEN ABS(sle.stock_value_difference) 
        ELSE 0 
    END), 2) as "Out Value:Currency:80",
    
    -- Valuation Rate (weighted average rate)
    ROUND(CASE 
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s THEN sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END) != 0 
        THEN SUM(CASE WHEN sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s THEN sle.stock_value_difference ELSE 0 END) / 
             SUM(CASE WHEN sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s THEN sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END)
        ELSE (
            SELECT sle2.valuation_rate 
            FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle2 
            WHERE sle2.item_code = sle.item_code 
            AND sle2.warehouse = sle.warehouse
            AND sle2.posting_date <= %(to_date)s
            AND sle2.docstatus < 2
            AND sle2.is_cancelled = 0
            ORDER BY sle2.posting_datetime DESC, sle2.creation DESC
            LIMIT 1
        )
    END, 2) as "Valuation Rate:Currency:90",
    
    -- Reserved Stock (from Stock Reservation Entry)
    COALESCE((
        SELECT SUM(sre.reserved_qty)
        FROM `tabStock Reservation Entry` sre
        WHERE sre.item_code = sle.item_code
        AND sre.warehouse = sle.warehouse
        AND sre.docstatus = 1 
        AND sre.status != 'Cancelled'
    ), 0) as "Reserved Stock:Float:80",
    
    MAX(sle.company) as "Company:Link/Company:100"

FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
INNER JOIN `tabItem` item ON sle.item_code = item.name

-- Left join to get opening status for Stock Entry
LEFT JOIN `tabStock Entry` se ON (
    sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Entry' 
    AND sle.voucher_no = se.name
    AND se.docstatus = 1
)

-- Left join to get purpose for Stock Reconciliation  
LEFT JOIN `tabStock Reconciliation` sr ON (
    sle.voucher_type = 'Stock Reconciliation' 
    AND sle.voucher_no = sr.name
    AND sr.docstatus = 1
)

WHERE 
    sle.docstatus < 2 
    AND sle.is_cancelled = 0
    AND (%(company)s IS NULL OR %(company)s = '' OR sle.company = %(company)s)
    AND (%(item_code)s IS NULL OR %(item_code)s = '' OR sle.item_code = %(item_code)s)
    AND (%(warehouse)s IS NULL OR %(warehouse)s = '' OR sle.warehouse = %(warehouse)s)
    AND (%(item_group)s IS NULL OR %(item_group)s = '' OR item.item_group IN (
        SELECT ig.name FROM `tabItem Group` ig
        WHERE ig.lft >= (SELECT lft FROM `tabItem Group` WHERE name = %(item_group)s)
        AND ig.rgt <= (SELECT rgt FROM `tabItem Group` WHERE name = %(item_group)s)
    ))

GROUP BY sle.item_code, sle.warehouse

HAVING 
    -- Only show items with transactions or current stock (unless show_zero_values is enabled)
    (%(show_zero_values)s = 1 
     OR ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s THEN sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END)) > 0.001
     OR ABS(SUM(CASE WHEN sle.posting_date <= %(to_date)s THEN sle.stock_value_difference ELSE 0 END)) > 0.01)

ORDER BY sle.item_code, sle.warehouse;

query:
SELECT
  i.item_code,
  i.item_name,
  i.brand,
  
  IFNULL(opening.opening_qty, 0) AS opening_stock,
  
  IFNULL(inward.qty_in, 0) AS qty_in,
  IFNULL(outward.qty_out, 0) AS qty_out,
  
  (IFNULL(opening.opening_qty, 0) + IFNULL(inward.qty_in, 0) - IFNULL(outward.qty_out, 0)) AS closing_stock

FROM
  `tabItem` i

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sle.item_code,
    SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS opening_qty
  FROM
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
  WHERE
    sle.posting_date < '{{ from_date }}'
  GROUP BY sle.item_code
) opening ON opening.item_code = i.item_code

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sle.item_code,
    SUM(sle.actual_qty) AS qty_in
  FROM
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
  WHERE
    sle.posting_date BETWEEN '{{ from_date }}' AND '{{ to_date }}'
    AND sle.actual_qty > 0
  GROUP BY sle.item_code
) inward ON inward.item_code = i.item_code

LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    sle.item_code,
    ABS(SUM(sle.actual_qty)) AS qty_out
  FROM
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
  WHERE
    sle.posting_date BETWEEN '{{ from_date }}' AND '{{ to_date }}'
    AND sle.actual_qty < 0
  GROUP BY sle.item_code
) outward ON outward.item_code = i.item_code

WHERE
  i.disabled = 0

ORDER BY
  i.item_code;

report_script:
# Get filters safely
customer = filters.get("customer")
opportunity = filters.get("opportunity")
from_date = filters.get("from_date")
to_date = filters.get("to_date")

# Columns
columns = [
    {"label": "Opportunity ID", "fieldname": "name", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Opportunity", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Customer", "fieldname": "party_name", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Customer", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Customer Name", "fieldname": "customer_name", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 200},
    {"label": "Customer's Sales Partner", "fieldname": "default_sales_partner", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sales Partner", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Customer's Sales Person", "fieldname": "custom_sales_person", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Sales Person", "width": 150},
    {"label": "Source", "fieldname": "source", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 120},
    {"label": "Status", "fieldname": "status", "fieldtype": "Data", "width": 100},
    {"label": "Owner", "fieldname": "opportunity_owner", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "User", "width": 150},
]

# Conditions list
conditions = ["o.docstatus < 2"]

if customer:
    conditions.append("o.party_name = %(customer)s")
if opportunity:
    conditions.append("o.name = %(opportunity)s")
if from_date:
    conditions.append("o.creation >= %(from_date)s")
if to_date:
    conditions.append("o.creation <= %(to_date)s")

where_clause = " AND ".join(conditions)

# Final SQL
query = f"""
    SELECT
        o.name,
        o.party_name,
        c.customer_name,
        c.default_sales_partner,
        c.custom_sales_person,
        o.source,
        o.status,
        o.opportunity_owner
    FROM
        `tabOpportunity` o
    LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` c ON o.party_name = c.name
    WHERE {where_clause}
    ORDER BY o.creation DESC
"""

# Run query
data = frappe.db.sql(query, filters, as_dict=True)

# Output
return columns, data

  si.name AS `Invoice ID:Link/Sales Invoice:150`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sii.sales_order SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Linked Sales Order(s):Data:150`,
  si.customer_name AS `Customer:Data:200`,

  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sii.rate SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Rate:Currency:120`,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sii.amount SEPARATOR ', ') AS `Amount:Currency:120`,
  si.grand_total AS `Grand Total:Currency:120`
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
  ON sii.parent = si.name
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
GROUP BY si.name
ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC

name: Credit balance with due date
query:
SELECT 
    si.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer:150",
    cust.customer_name AS "Customer Name::150",
    COALESCE(ccl.credit_limit, 0) AS "Credit Limit:Currency:120",
    SUM(si.outstanding_amount) AS "Outstanding Amount:Currency:120",
    (COALESCE(ccl.credit_limit, 0) - SUM(si.outstanding_amount)) AS "Credit Balance:Currency:120",
    MIN(si.due_date) AS "Earliest Overdue Due Date:Date:120",
    GROUP_CONCAT(si.name SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Overdue Invoices::300"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si
JOIN `tabCustomer` cust ON cust.name = si.customer
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        parent AS customer,
        MAX(credit_limit) AS credit_limit
    FROM `tabCustomer Credit Limit`
    WHERE company = 'Default Company'
    GROUP BY parent
) ccl ON ccl.customer = si.customer  -- Ensuring correct mapping
WHERE si.docstatus = 1
  AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
  AND si.due_date < CURDATE()
GROUP BY si.customer, cust.customer_name, ccl.credit_limit
ORDER BY MIN(si.due_date) ASC;

name: Give Physical vs System stock deviation report
query:
SELECT 
    sri.item_code AS "Item Code",  -- From the child table Stock Reconciliation Item
    i.item_name AS "Item Name",    -- Join with Item table to get the item name
    sri.warehouse AS "Warehouse",  
    sri.qty AS "Physical Stock",   -- Quantity entered in Stock Reconciliation Item
    sle.qty_after_transaction AS "System Stock",  -- System stock from Stock Ledger Entry
    (sri.qty - sle.qty_after_transaction) AS "Stock Deviation",  -- Difference between physical and system stock
    sr.posting_date AS "Reconciliation Date"  -- The date of Stock Reconciliation
FROM 
    `tabStock Reconciliation` sr  -- Main Stock Reconciliation table
JOIN 
    `tabStock Reconciliation Item` sri ON sr.name = sri.parent  -- Join with Stock Reconciliation Item (child table)
JOIN 
    `tabItem` i ON sri.item_code = i.item_code  -- Join with Item table to get the item name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle ON sle.item_code = sri.item_code 
    AND sle.warehouse = sri.warehouse
    AND sle.posting_date <= sr.posting_date  -- Use posting_date for the correct system stock
WHERE 
    sr.docstatus = 1  -- Only include submitted Stock Reconciliation records
ORDER BY 
    sr.posting_date DESC;

query:

    soi.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item:120",

    po.transaction_date AS "PO Date:Date"

    so.status NOT IN ('Completed', 'Cancelled')

name: Stock Deficiency Report
query:
SELECT 
    sle.item_code,
    i.item_name,
    COALESCE(SUM(sle.actual_qty), 0) AS current_stock,
    COALESCE(SUM(so.total_order_qty), 0) AS sales_order_qty,
    (COALESCE(SUM(sle.actual_qty), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(so.total_order_qty), 0)) AS deficiency,
    COALESCE(SUM(po.total_order_qty), 0) AS purchase_order_qty,
    (COALESCE(SUM(sle.actual_qty), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(so.total_order_qty), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(po.total_order_qty), 0)) AS shortfall_after_po
FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry` sle
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_code, SUM(qty) AS total_order_qty
    FROM `tabSales Order Item`
    WHERE docstatus = 1  -- Only consider confirmed sales orders
    GROUP BY item_code
) so ON sle.item_code = so.item_code
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT item_code, SUM(qty) AS total_order_qty
    FROM `tabPurchase Order Item`
    WHERE docstatus = 1  -- Only consider confirmed purchase orders
    GROUP BY item_code
) po ON sle.item_code = po.item_code
LEFT JOIN `tabItem` i ON sle.item_code = i.name
GROUP BY sle.item_code, i.item_name
ORDER BY deficiency ASC;

name: Partially delivered sales orders:
query:
SELECT 
    so.name AS "Sales Order",
    so.customer AS "Customer",
    so.status AS "Sales Order Status",
    SUM(soi.qty) AS "Ordered Qty",
    IFNULL(SUM(dni.qty), 0) AS "Delivered Qty",
    (SUM(soi.qty) - IFNULL(SUM(dni.qty), 0)) AS "Pending Qty",
    'Partially Delivered' AS "Delivery Status"
FROM 
    `tabSales Order` so
JOIN 
    `tabSales Order Item` soi ON soi.parent = so.name
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabDelivery Note Item` dni ON soi.item_code = dni.item_code 
    AND soi.parent = dni.against_sales_order
LEFT JOIN 
    `tabDelivery Note` dn ON dni.parent = dn.name
    AND dn.docstatus = 1  -- Only consider submitted deliveries
WHERE 
    so.docstatus = 1  -- Only consider submitted sales orders
    AND so.status = "To Deliver and Bill"  -- Filter by required Sales Order status
GROUP BY 
    so.name
HAVING 
    SUM(dni.qty) > 0  -- At least some quantity is delivered
    AND SUM(dni.qty) < SUM(soi.qty)  -- Not fully delivered (i.e., still pending)
ORDER BY 
    so.transaction_date DESC;

name: Sales Pipeline Report
query:
import frappe

def execute(filters=None):
    query = """
        SELECT 
            sales_stage AS `Sales Stage`,
            COUNT(name) AS `Open Opportunities`,
            SUM(opportunity_amount) AS `Expected Revenue`,
            ROUND(
                (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'Converted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(name), 0), 
                2
            ) AS `Conversion Rate (%)`
        FROM 
            `tabOpportunity`
        WHERE 
            status NOT IN ('Lost', 'Closed')
            {date_filter}
        GROUP BY 
            sales_stage
        ORDER BY 
            SUM(opportunity_amount) DESC;
    """

    # Handle date filtering safely
    date_filter = ""
    params = {}

    if filters.get("from_date") and filters.get("to_date"):
        date_filter = "AND transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s"
        params["from_date"] = filters["from_date"]
        params["to_date"] = filters["to_date"]

    query = query.format(date_filter=date_filter)

    # Execute query safely
    data = frappe.db.sql(query, params, as_dict=True)
    return data

name: Material Request with Customer and Supplier Details
query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    mr.name AS "Material Request:Link/Material Request:150",
    mr.transaction_date AS "MR Date:Date:110",

    -- Sales Order & Customer
    so.name AS "Sales Order:Link/Sales Order:150",
    COALESCE(so.customer_name, cust.customer_name) AS "Customer Name:Data:200",

    -- Delivery Date (prefers SO Item's date, else SO header)
    COALESCE(soi.delivery_date, so.delivery_date) AS "SO Delivery Date:Date:120",

    -- Purchase Order & Supplier
    po.name AS "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:150",
    COALESCE(po.supplier_name, sup.supplier_name) AS "Supplier Name:Data:200",
    po.transaction_date AS "PO Date:Date:110"

FROM `tabMaterial Request` mr
LEFT JOIN `tabMaterial Request Item` mri
    ON mri.parent = mr.name

/* Link to Sales Order via Sales Order Item (robust across setups) */
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Order Item` soi
    ON soi.name = mri.sales_order_item
LEFT JOIN `tabSales Order` so
    ON so.name = COALESCE(mri.sales_order, soi.parent)

/* (Optional) Join Customer for name fallback if needed */
LEFT JOIN `tabCustomer` cust
    ON cust.name = so.customer

/* Link PO Items created against this MR or a specific MR Item */
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
    ON (poi.material_request = mr.name OR poi.material_request_item = mri.name)
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Order` po
    ON po.name = poi.parent

/* (Optional) Join Supplier for name fallback if needed */
LEFT JOIN `tabSupplier` sup
    ON sup.name = po.supplier

WHERE mr.transaction_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
ORDER BY mr.transaction_date DESC, mr.name DESC;
